request: Build me a rental contracts module with lines, statuses and a board.

outcome.renderedDiff:
Publishes Board “Rental contracts board” for Rental contract. Stages are Draft, Active, Ended, Cancelled. Available moves are Activate, Cancel active contract, Cancel draft, End contract. Card facts are Start date, End date, Notes.
New record type "Rental contract" with 5 fields:
  - State (one of "Draft", "Active", "Ended", "Cancelled", required)
  - Contract name (text, required)
  - Start date (date)
  - End date (date)
  - Notes (text)
  Each record belongs to one company.
  It gets its own menu entry "Rental contract" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Rental contract records.
New line table "Rental lines" on Rental contract:
  - Line number (whole number, required)
  - Description (text, required)
  - Quantity (whole number)
  - Rate (whole number)
  Each record belongs to one company.
New lifecycle for Rental contract. Records start at "Draft".
  - Activate changes "Draft" to "Active" after confirmation.
  - End contract changes "Active" to "Ended" after confirmation.
  - Cancel draft changes "Draft" to "Cancelled" after confirmation.
  - Cancel active contract changes "Active" to "Cancelled" after confirmation.

Stored data: 2 new tables, addForeignKey, 3 new indexes. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
